changes.q: Entry fact: Tony builds the armor before the crash, not after
now: Teenage Tony Stark builds his armor after his father's plane goes down.
proposed: Teenage Tony Stark's armor saves his life when his father's plane goes down, and he becomes Iron Man.
changes.evidence: Episode 1 (Iron, Forged in Fire Part 1): teen Tony has just finished the Iron Man armor before he can show his dad; Howard dies in the plane crash and Tony barely survives when the exo-suit he already built implants a device in his chest. He then uses the suit and the media dub him Iron Man. The armor is not built after the crash.

changes.q: Entry fact for #26: in episode 26 the Squad works with Doctor Doom rather than stopping his hunt
now: The Super Hero Squad stops Doctor Doom's hunt for the Infinity Sword.
proposed: When Galactus comes to devour Earth, the Super Hero Squad gets Doctor Doom to help reforge the Infinity Sword.
changes.evidence: Episode 26 (season 1 finale): Galactus arrives in Super Hero City; the Squad must convince Doctor Doom to help reforge the Infinity Sword, which the Silver Surfer then wields before becoming Galactus' herald again. The current text is the premise of season 1 as a whole (Squad racing Doom's Lethal Legion for the fractals), not what happens in #26.

changes.q: Entry fact: Sue does not make the trip to Planet Zero
now: Reed, Sue, Johnny, Ben and Victor are changed by a trip to another dimension.
proposed: Reed, Johnny, Ben and Victor make an unsanctioned trip here, and Victor is left behind when the ground erupts.
changes.evidence: Plot: Reed, Johnny, Victor and Ben use the Quantum Gate to travel to Planet Zero; Sue stays at the lab and brings them back. Victor falls into the collapsing landscape and is left behind. Reed, Sue, Johnny and Ben are changed when the Quantum Gate explodes back on Earth, so Sue was never on the trip and the four were not changed at Planet Zero itself.
